query:
SELECT e.id, e.description, e.amount, e.categoryId, e.managementAccountId, e.accountingCode, p.name as supplierName
FROM expenses e
LEFT JOIN partners p ON e.supplierId = p.id
WHERE e.status != 'CANCELADA'
ORDER BY e.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 30;
